title: pentacyphus lehmannii subsp. tamanus
intro: Pentacyphus lehmannii subsp. tamanus, commonly known as Tamanu or Foraha, is a plant native to tropical regions of the Pacific Islands, known for its valuable medicinal and cosmetic properties. The health benefits of Tamanu oil include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it an effective treatment for skin conditions such as acne, eczema, and psoriasis. The therapeutic actions of Tamanu oil include promoting tissue regeneration, reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting the skin from damage caused by UV radiation. The bioactive constituents of Tamanu oil include calophyllic acid, tamanu oil, and other fatty acids, which contribute to its healing and protective properties.
